dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge forming a smooth falcate spline from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a moderate pixel radius, classified as obtuse.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear ascending margin positioned at approximately 35-40 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, large-radius convex arc forming a bulbous forehead profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick beak protruding anteriorly from the melon base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Clearly defined obtuse angle at the transition from the melon slope to the rostrum dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable white depigmentation or scarring visible on the distal tip and trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant high-contrast light caustic patterns visible across the dorsal and mid-lateral skin surfaces.
